name: Grok-1

lifecycle.note: Refers to the open base-model weights, which remain downloadable from xAI's Hugging Face and GitHub repositories. xAI published no end-of-service notice for the fine-tuned Grok-1 that powered Grok at launch.

released.note: The model card says the initial Grok-1 was released in Nov 2023. The announcement of 2023-11-03 offered early access to a limited number of users in the United States through a waitlist.

milestones.label: Base model weights released under Apache 2.0

date.note: The released checkpoint is the raw base model from the pre-training phase that concluded in October 2023, not fine-tuned for dialogue.

summary.text: Grok-1 is the language model xAI developed for its Grok assistant, announced on 3 November 2023 and first offered as limited early access to users in the United States. It is a 314-billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model, and on 17 March 2024 xAI released its base model weights under the Apache 2.0 licence.

inputModalities.note: The announcement says Grok did not yet have other senses such as vision and audio.

parameters.note: Mixture-of-Experts model; xAI says 25% of the weights are active on a given token (2 of 8 experts per the repository).

openWeights.note: Base model weights and network architecture under the Apache 2.0 licence, released 2024-03-17.

access.note: Consumer access started as limited early access for users in the United States; the open weights followed in March 2024.

notes: xAI uses Grok for the assistant product and Grok-1 for the model behind it at launch. Grok-0, a 33B prototype mentioned in the announcement, was never released and has no record. No predecessor relation: first public xAI model.
